claims.text: The Assembly reports that Interim Speaker Lord Tangi confirmed that the meeting of the Elected Representatives to elect the Prime Minister would be held on Wednesday 15 December 2021 at 10am, and that one nomination had so far been received, on Monday 13 December 2021. It states that the Speaker and Deputy Speaker would be elected at the same meeting after the Prime Minister election result is declared.
claims.uncertainty: An advance notice. It does not record that the meeting took place or its result, and names no candidate.
